assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only the two reviewed items curated on tomozaki:mizusawa-takahiro@light-novel at basis_commit, each read in full: #provisional-character-study, the canonical Mizusawa Takahiro character monograph (generation V12_REVIEWED_MIZUSAWA, maturity MATURE_LOCAL_LITERARY_ROLE, independent review pass 2026-10-23), covering the locked Japanese main V01-V12 with story-locally routed V06.5/V08.5 and five selective primary-return windows MZ-P01 to MZ-P05 (V03, V06.5, V12); and #bounded-reconstruction-model, the canonical derived-use model TOMOZAKI_MIZUSAWA_P06_MODEL_V1, marked do_not_use_as_primary_literary_authority, which derives from that monograph and is not used as literary evidence. The project's current-state entrypoint and the models README were read for method and gate state only. The integration reviews, evidence and review packets, post-release validation, sequential readings and ledgers to which these items route are not curated on this subject and are not evidence here. His interpretations of Hinami and himself are evidence of his own present model, not of her mind. No adaptation, performed voice, reception or post-V12 material is in scope.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: The model's eight selectors: MZ_EARLY_PEER_FORM (V01-V02 portable social form), MZ03_CAMP_POST_REFUSAL (V03 declaration and Hinami's refusal), MZ65_BAR_WAITING (V06.5 near-summer-end bar work and the addressed waiting statement, whose seam to individual V03 scenes stays open), MZ05_06_PEER_HELP (V05-V06), MZ08_EXPLORATION (V08 university-first plan), MZ10_NEGOTIATION (V10 Endo barter with three-month, six-month and renewal terms kept distinct), MZ11_HERO_QUESTION (V11) and MZ12_FRIENDSHIP_COLLAB (V12), with the monograph's V04, V07 and V09 chronology rows as context. Scene clock, publication clock and the actor's stated policy are selected separately; V05-V11 claims rest on refreshed readings rather than a new full primary rereading; nothing after V12 is established and no earlier state acquires later knowledge.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The monograph's thesis is that existing social competence becomes personally consequential when attached to an owned end (sections 2, 6, 6.1), tested against six rival readings with dispositions (section 12) and against a non-monotonic policy account (section 3.1). The model operationalizes it as seven conditional mechanisms ZM1-ZM7, each with conditions, a counterweight and a source route. B is not supported because the model states there is no stable hierarchy among presentation, affection, risk and self-protection and that confidence is weaker for new balances of mixed motives; the monograph calls its central account provisional and says V05-V11 claims were refreshed against readings, not freshly reread. Conditional mechanisms with counterweights and rejected rivals exceed a descriptive profile, so D is not supported.

The monograph gives a V01-V12 chronology table with an analytical limit per boundary (section 3), a three-clock table separating what is directly available from what remains interpretation for V03, V06.5, V05-V06, V10-V11 and V12 (section 3.1), and a V12 state vector with per-variable confidence (section 4). The model binds behavior to eight selectors with a stated information ceiling for each. A is not supported because the V03/V06.5 seam is left open, V07-V08 have limited event focus, and V05-V11 were not freshly reread at primary level; an undifferentiated period profile would ignore the per-state ceilings, so C would understate the explicit bounded state tracking.

The monograph locates recipient-specific communicative acts: affectionate complaint and coordinated joking with Yuji, reciprocal teasing with Gumi, deferential casual replies to the bar master, an unusual unjoking interval in V12, face-covering embarrassment, teasing recovery and direct thanks (sections 5.1, 8.5, 9.1-9.2), and the model lists these as local communicative controls. C is not supported because the discovery row does not claim speech, the evidence quotes almost no wording, and the model states that no complete idiolect, freeform Japanese dialogue or acoustic profile is validated; recipient-differentiated register cells with paragraph-located windows exceed a single prose description, so E is not supported.

Located ordinary behavior: occasional bar work at his brother's request with complaint and private enjoyment, remembered introductions and nonalcohol drinks for visitors, a fist bump and surname joke with Yuji (V06.5, section 9.1); a large yakitori bowl during a V12 work break (section 9.2); and a V08 plan of ordinary university first with his brother's beauty work as an interest (section 9.3). The model turns this into ZM6, familiar work enjoyed before a final destination. B is not supported because section 9.4 states that wardrobe, music, diet, sleep, household economy and response to unfamiliar recipients are unknown and the returns are selected windows; located episodes across three volumes with a modeled mechanism exceed listed habits, so D is not supported.

The monograph differentiates Tomozaki (mentor become reciprocal friend, ethically mixed V10 receipt), Hinami (owned romantic end with a controlling V03 refusal), Tama and the peer group, professional-game contacts, and a recipient table for Yuji, Gumi, the visitors, the bar master and Kikuchi with access constraints (sections 8.1-8.6). The model makes recipient, directional standing and the absent owner of information a mandatory gate. A is not supported because Hinami's side is available only through her V03 answer, responses to unfamiliar recipients are unknown, and the shared third-party ethics account is left to a pending specialist; differentiated, access-bounded responses across several attested recipients exceed a relational sketch, so C would understate it.

Access comes mainly through his own located self-reports, read with stated epistemic status: pain and relief after the V03 refusal, the V06.5 admission of liking and waiting policy, the V11 recognition of a possible hero fantasy, and the V12 unjoking self-condemnation, which the monograph treats as direct evidence of a present judgment and not a total motive census (sections 3.1, 7, 10.1). B is not supported because he is mostly seen through Fumiya's narration, the monograph rejects treating a hidden lonely self as more authentic than the performed one, and Fumiya is not an infallible sincerity detector (section 10); located self-reports with explicit limits exceed inference from behavior alone, so D is not supported.

Located conflict and pressure: acknowledgment of pain and continued liking after refusal (ZM2, MZ-P01), the V10 barter in which a covert nudge secures Fumiya's public assent to a target Mizusawa proposed (ZM5, section 9.3), and initial resistance to unscripted role-play followed by one bounded attempt (ZM7, MZ-P05). B is not supported because there is no observed response to a renewed refusal, no stopping rule, and few direct interpersonal disputes; mechanism-level treatment with counterweights exceeds located incidents alone, so D is not supported.

The evidence shows his own moral reflection as well as acts: refusing in V05 to extract Hinami's information from Fumiya, naming a possible hero fantasy in V11, admitting in V12 that access to Hinami was one motive for contact, and accepting a particular sharing about himself while that acceptance cannot authorize Hinami's history (sections 6.1, 7, 8.6, 10.1). B is not supported because much of the weighing (informational entitlement, consent to pursuit) is the monograph's evaluation rather than his rendered deliberation, and the monograph assigns the shared ethics account to a pending specialist; his self-evaluation exceeds mere positions, so D is not supported.

Located play: banter and a coordinated surname joke and fist bump with Yuji, reciprocal teasing with Gumi, playful name exchange with the visitors (section 8.5), and teasing recovery after embarrassment in V12; the model treats teasing as one available act under ZM1 and notes that the unusual unjoking interval is discriminating precisely because joking is his familiar manner. B is not supported because humor is described rather than sampled and no idiolect is validated; recipient-specific play across V06.5 and V12 with a discriminating contrast exceeds a single mention, so D is not supported.

Two dedicated reviewed items: a mature A-scope monograph with independent review through V12 and five primary-return registers, and a root-accepted bounded model derived from it. B is not supported because the monograph states that its fresh primary returns cover only V03, the bar story and selected V12 passages, that V05-V11 were refreshed against readings, and that an all-fourteen coverage reconciliation and relationship and ethics specialists remain pending; the readings, ledgers, integration reviews and review packets are not curated on this subject. Two dedicated items spanning V01-V12 exceed limited local evidence, so D is not supported.

Affirmative limits and countercases are systematic: the V03 refusal stays controlling and later fiction cannot revise it; the V10 receipt of Hinami's history follows an acknowledged privacy violation; the covert nudge means Fumiya's public assent was not equal prior authorship; role-play was resisted before one attempt; his self-condemnation is not a total motive census; and section 11.1 lists seven tensions the account must not smooth away, with section 12 rejecting six rivals. A is not supported because these are interpretive dispositions over selective returns rather than exhaustive tests; located failures and countercases exceed bare gap statements, so C would understate them.

The monograph separates scene clock, publication clock and stated policy (section 3.1), keeps the V03/V06.5 seam explicitly open rather than fabricating an order, and binds windows to members and paragraph ranges (MZ-P01 to P05); the model refuses 'summer' or 'late Mizusawa' as selectors where they would decide waiting versus pursuit and keeps the three-month, six-month and renewal terms distinct. A is not supported because the seam is open, V07-V08 are thin and V05-V11 rest on refreshed readings; per-state ceilings and paragraph-bounded windows exceed a loose period, so C would understate them.

known_limits.statement: Hinami's V03 refusal remains the controlling answer through V12; no renewed declaration or new reply is shown, and the fictional Sharif exchange and her later readership cannot revise it.

The relation between the V06.5 near-summer-end waiting statement and individual V03 scenes is explicitly unpinned; neither the V03 persistence nor the waiting policy may be erased to force one progress story.
Receiving Hinami's history through Fumiya's acknowledged violation, and accepting a particular sharing about himself in V12, give neither Mizusawa nor Fumiya authority over Hinami's information.
His V12 admission of one instrumental motive for contact and his self-description as only calculating are present judgments, not proof that every friendship act was a means to Hinami.
The V10 barter's three-month target, six-month promotion and later renewal are distinct facts; a covert nudge preceded Fumiya's public assent, and one negotiation is not a career.
The V12 acting contribution followed real resistance and was one bounded attempt; it is not enthusiasm, a general acting preference or standing availability.
His account of Hinami's hidden loneliness is his conjecture and a recognized hero-fantasy risk, not her testimony or authenticated interior.
The monograph's V05-V11 claims were refreshed against readings and ledgers rather than a new full primary rereading, and the coverage reconciliation that would test them is not in this evidence set.

The integration review, evidence and review packet, post-release validation, readings and ledgers to which both items route are not curated on this subject, so their test records and locators were not rechecked here.
No complete idiolect, quoted wording set, freeform Japanese dialogue or acoustic performance is in evidence; register is described as local communicative acts only.

Wardrobe, music, diet, sleep, household economy, educational ambition beyond the V08 plan, private romantic history and responses to unfamiliar recipients are not established; this is a gap, not evidence of incapacity.
Whether he confesses again, any reply or stopping rule, sustained negotiation work and the durability of the V12 friendship are not established; nothing after V12 is assessed.
